scope: visual revision; existing host social/ranking services remain authoritative
ranking: Use server rank, score, ties and pagination. Do not sort the visible window to invent global rank. Player metric follows current level-based product rule; team score uses server value.
top3: Present only authoritative ranks1–3; fewer results leave unused slots absent. Rest of list begins at4 without duplication.
selfRow: Pinned current-player rank in current scope, or not-ranked state. Teams tab pins current team only if member. No membership implied from demo values.
regions: Explicit country selection; do not infer from language, device, account or IP. Draft selection commits only on Select. World data independent of region. No location permission.
friends: Profile tap opens existing player profile; Add opens find-friends. Request becomes Sent only on confirmed backend result. More opens existing management flow; removal requires confirmation.
noBackend: Preview values are fixtures. No real requests, removals, messages, rewards or rank changes.
navigation: Preserve shared Home dock artwork/behavior. Friends/Players/Teams are page tabs, not new bottom-nav destinations.
motion: 180ms page opacity;140ms tab crossfade; no rank reordering animation during scroll; reduced motion opacity only.
